scope: 54 deliberately stratified pilot events; no population precision estimate
review_status: provisional single AI visual review of private frame sequences; no independent human adjudication

review_context.frame_source: original pilot MP4 at Stage 4 raw sample timestamps
review_context.video_09_detail: four events additionally inspected at native 30 fps around edit boundaries
review_context.blinding: first-pass frame sheets carried only audit ID, video ref and timestamp; final labels recorded after detector classes were inspected

selection.method: fixed per-class and per-source quotas; select across event-duration quantiles and alternating lower/higher confidence; seeded ID shuffle

definitions.sample_precision: exact label agreement among determinate reviewed events in this selected sample; unknown has no exact semantic target
definitions.raw_class_support_interval_seconds: half-open union of the raw sample cells carrying this baseline class run; avoids baseline transition overlap
definitions.survives_same_detector_class: positive temporal overlap between raw class support and an emitted event of the same detector class
definitions.survives_any_emitted_event: positive temporal overlap between raw class support and any emitted event, even a different class
definitions.visually_valid: reviewed as camera, local subject or general scene motion; uncertain excluded
definitions.obvious_noise: reviewed no_meaningful_motion, primarily abrupt edits or graphic changes; uncertain excluded
